name: courseline-canvas
description: Lets Claude read your own Canvas courses: assignments, grades, pages, files and quiz results. Read-only.
long_description: Gives Claude read-only tools for your Canvas LMS account, using your own access token: your courses and grades, what is due, assignment instructions and rubrics, your scores, teacher comments and rubric scores, which quiz questions you got right and wrong (classic quizzes, as far as Canvas shows them), course pages, and the text of course files (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel). It runs on your computer and talks only to your school's Canvas. Nothing in Canvas is changed.

tools.name: get_upcoming
tools.description: What is due soon across all courses

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: A course's assignments with your status and score

tools.name: get_assignment
tools.description: One assignment: instructions, rubric, your result and quiz answers

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: A file's text (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) or an image

tools.name: search_course
tools.description: Search a course's syllabus, pages and assignments

canvas_token.description: In Canvas: Account → Settings → New access token. Kept in your system keychain.
